description:
Look up the water solubility of five chemicals on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) and save a ranked assessment of groundwater contamination risk to '/home/ga/Documents/groundwater_risk_assessment.txt'.

The five chemicals are:
1. Benzene (CAS 71-43-2)
2. Sodium Hydroxide (CAS 1310-73-2)
3. Trichloroethylene (CAS 79-01-6)
4. Phenol (CAS 108-95-2)
5. Carbon Tetrachloride (CAS 56-23-5)

For each chemical, the file must include:
- Chemical Name
- Water Solubility Value (from the Physical Properties section)
- Groundwater Risk Level (HIGH for >50 mg/mL, MEDIUM for 1-50 mg/mL, LOW for <1 mg/mL)

Finally, explicitly identify which single chemical poses the HIGHEST risk.
